summary: React Query Migration Batch 7 - Testing 4 migrated components. Fixed critical bugs in LeavePolicySettings.js and ConsultingSOWList.js where array methods were called on non-array responses from failed API calls. Also added defensive coding to PaymentVerification.js, ConsultingProjectTasks.js, and ClientPortal.js.

minor.issue: Returns 404 Not Found - endpoint may not exist or be configured

action_items: Verify /api/masters/departments endpoint exists in backend or remove dependency from LeavePolicySettings.js
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: LeavePolicySettings.js - 'employees.map is not a function' error when API returns error object instead of array
FIXED: ConsultingSOWList.js - 'leads.find is not a function' error when leads API fails
IMPROVED: Added Array.isArray() checks to all 4 React Query migrated files for defensive coding
Pattern applied: Always use Array.isArray(response.data) ? response.data : [] in queryFn
Pattern applied: Always use Array.isArray(data) ? data : [] when deriving from query data
context_for_next_testing_agent: React Query migration testing complete for Batch 7. Fixed critical bugs where API error responses (objects) were being treated as arrays. The pattern to follow for all React Query migrations: 1) Use Array.isArray() in queryFn return, 2) Use Array.isArray() when deriving state from query data. ConsultingSOWList.js was also fixed (not in original 4 files but was blocking access to ConsultingProjectTasks). ClientPortal requires separate client authentication.
